pinterest.title: How to check if an AI label stays on after export
pinterest.description: If you publish client work with AI help, ask one thing before you send it: does the label still show after export? If it disappears, don’t assume the file explains itself. Save this check for later.Produced with AI assistance and released with human approval by Clearforge.
